g.text: Can target practice wait until tomorrow? I beg of you! I'm trying to sleep!
uh... that message was meant for Quincy. sry... pls ignore this
Sounds like you're having a tough time.
no srsly. u can ignore this.
it's fiiine. this is a big mall. I can always find somewhere further from Quincy to nap
I'm sure he doesn't need to shoot things at *all* hours.
You seem upset. Is it something I said?
nah it's for the best that I didn't reach him. he needs to let off steam. I get it.
I can say something to Arthur for you, if you want.
As long as you're getting enough sleep, that's cool.
I didn't love being called boring.
uh... I appreciate the thought, but if that was a good idea, I'd talk to Arthur myself :P
u wouldn't believe how cozy clothing stores can be
Oh. I really didn't mean anything by it.
Hey, I get it. I'd never tell Ordis how his jokes keep me up sometimes.
You should really look out for yourself more though.
Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
You're not boring, Aoi. I just thought I was being clever.
If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
You're always thinking about other people. I hope you don't forget about yourself.
Maybe I overstepped. It wasn't really my place to say that.
It seems the jury's convinced by your defense
Yeah, he's the Cephalon intelligence that runs my spacecraft.
No, he's the Cephalon intelligence that runs my spacecraft.
I just don't see looking out for others as separate from looking out for myself
and grants you a fresh start
a Cephalon is like a... wut exactly?
Surely there are exceptions to that rule.
I just don't see looking out for others as separate from looking out for myself
ew I feel like I need to shower after reading that
They're people whose consciousness was uploaded to virtual space (usually by force.)
maybe we both need to sleep and reset, ya?
Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.
:) I'll have nightmares about that now
I respect others too much to accept bad behavior from them and respect myself too much to tolerate it
Damn. There I go sabotaging your sleep further.
What about people you don't respect?
Sounds like you're tolerating bad behavior from Quincy.
u and Quincy are quite the pair :P
why? wondering how I might feel about u? ;)
u mean target practice? I dunno. sounds like u have a low bar for bad behavior lol
Maybe a little too futuristic to explain, honestly.
Your reaction to things that were normal to the Orokin is a good reality check for me.
I'm talking about him ignoring the needs of those around him.
well Ordis is lucky to have u
I respect u enough to let you find ur own answers to existential questions
sure, he shoots at odd hours, but I see ignoring it as a chance to do something kind for someone who truly deserves it
And I'm very lucky to have him.
anyway none of this cheery talk concerns Quincy :P
my respect is freely given, but it can be lost
All right, then. It's clear I can't convince you otherwise.
Your outlook does have a certain charm to it.
No, but it does concern you, so it interests me.
when that happens, I just stop caring and treat the person like anything else that holds no importance to me
time for me to go find a nice place to sleep
